programs.title: 1. Moving with the keys
programs.description: Turn and drive along an entity's own axes (TurnEntity, MoveEntity), or slide along the world's axes (TranslateEntity), at speeds in units per second.
programs.controls: Arrows or WASD move, C changes between the tank and the ball, R resets

programs.title: 2. Controlling an animation
programs.description: Pick a model's animation, change its speed, pause it and step through it, and play a jump once before going back.
programs.controls: 1-4 pick an animation, Up/Down speed, P pause, Left/Right step while paused, Space jump, Q/E turn

programs.title: 3. Walking a character
programs.description: A character that walks where the camera looks, runs and jumps, with collisions, animations that follow what it does, and a camera that follows it without going into walls.
programs.controls: Arrows or WASD walk, Shift runs, Space jumps, Q/E or drag turn the camera

programs.title: 4. First-person camera
programs.description: Mouse look (LockPointer), walking and jumping in a walled courtyard: the body turns left and right, the camera looks up and down.
programs.controls: Click to take the mouse (Esc gives it back) or drag to look, WASD walk, Shift run, Space jump

programs.title: 5. Free-look camera
programs.description: A camera that flies anywhere: forward is wherever it looks.
programs.controls: Drag to look (right click takes the mouse), WASD fly, Q/E down and up, Shift faster, R back to the start

programs.title: 6. Orbit camera
programs.description: Turn round a model and zoom, as model viewers do; the camera stands back by each model's size.
programs.controls: Drag to turn, mouse wheel or Z/X zoom, N next model

programs.title: Spinning cube
programs.description: The hello world of PolyBasic 3D: a camera, a light and a textured cube turning in Update().

programs.title: Block Rain
programs.description: A small game: dodge the falling blocks. Types, For Each, input, and a 2D score on top.
programs.controls: Arrows or WASD, or drag with the mouse or a finger; Space or a tap to start

programs.title: Orbits
programs.description: Parents and children: a moon turns around a planet that turns around a sun.
programs.controls: Left/Right turn the camera, mouse wheel zooms

programs.title: Coin Hop
programs.description: A small platformer with glTF models by Kenney: collisions keep the character on the platforms, and its walk, idle and jump animations come from the model file.
programs.controls: Arrows or WASD run, Space jumps

programs.title: Crate Tower
programs.description: Physics: throw heavy balls at a tower of crates and watch it fall. The program gives things bodies; the physics engine does the rest.
programs.controls: Click or tap to throw, Left/Right turn the view, R builds a new tower

programs.title: Paint Shapes
programs.description: Picking: point at a shape to see its name, click to paint it. Labels follow the shapes with CameraProject.
programs.controls: Mouse or finger; right click or P switches the picking mode

programs.title: Sound Lab
programs.description: Sound made by the engine, with no files: ready-made effects, a song with a beat to follow, and a bee heard in 3D, from ear to ear and higher as it comes closer.
programs.controls: 1 to 8 play effects, Space a variation, Left/Right turn, M music on or off

programs.title: Meadow
programs.description: Everything drawn by code: hills built from a height function, grown trees, grass that parts as you walk through it, sun shadows, fireflies with ribbon trails, and flowers pressed onto the ground where you click.
programs.controls: Arrows or WASD walk, click or tap the ground to plant a flower

programs.title: Shadows
programs.description: The sun and a lamp cast shadows (LightShadows); a shape can cast none (FX_NOSHADOWCAST) and a surface take none (FX_NOSHADOWRECV).
programs.controls: Left/Right turn the view, A/D turn the sun, 1 to 4 switch the shadows

programs.title: Texture flags
programs.description: A fence cut out with TEX_MASKED, a stained-glass window with TEX_ALPHA and a sign with TEX_CLAMPU and TEX_CLAMPV: each key swaps a texture with and without its flag.
programs.controls: Left/Right turn the view, 1 2 3 switch the flags

programs.title: Sprites
programs.description: A campfire at night: glowing sparks (EntityBlend 3), smoke that blends (TEX_ALPHA) and signposts that stand upright (SpriteViewMode 4).
programs.controls: Left/Right turn the view, Space more wood

programs.title: Building meshes
programs.description: A flag waving in the wind, its vertices moved every step (VertexCoords, UpdateNormals), and a gem built from triangles with vertex colours.
programs.controls: Left/Right turn the view, Up/Down wind, F flat or smooth

programs.title: Decals
programs.description: Paint splats and scorch marks pressed onto what you click, cut to the shapes under them, and carried along by the sliding crate.
programs.controls: Click paint, right click or S + click scorch, Left/Right turn, C clean up

programs.title: Ribbon trails
programs.description: A sword's swing, three comets and a ribbon you draw with the pointer, each the trail of two points as they move.
programs.controls: Space swing, hold the mouse and move to draw, 1 2 3 trail length

programs.title: Trees
programs.description: The seven kinds CreateTree grows, with their names; every seed grows another tree of the same kind.
programs.controls: Left/Right walk round, Up/Down closer, Space new seed, W wind

programs.title: Grass
programs.description: A field swaying in the wind, parted by a ball rolling through it; click to paint more tufts.
programs.controls: Arrows or WASD roll the ball, click to paint grass, 1/2 wind, C mow, R sow again

programs.title: Language tour
programs.description: Variables, loops, functions, arrays, Types and Select, printed to the console.

programs.title: Bouncing balls (console)
programs.description: The Update/Draw frame loop without graphics: balls move in Update, Draw prints a report.
